scope: Point Township / lower Wabash-Ohio community, expandable across Tri-State River Valley

assets.purpose: Effective federal flood-hazard and insurance reference
assets.freshnessPolicy: Use the current effective FEMA product; preserve FIRM panel and effective-date identifiers; never substitute historical screenshots for current regulatory mapping.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash downloaded product/metadata manifests; preserve FEMA panel and effective-date identifiers.

assets.dataset: Indiana Best Available Flood Hazard Layer
assets.purpose: Indiana floodplain planning and Flood Control Act context; not a FEMA NFHL insurance determination
assets.freshnessPolicy: Refresh from the current Indiana DNR service; retain service metadata, version identifiers, retrieval timestamp, and feature attributes. Best Available is not silently substituted for FEMA effective mapping.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash service metadata and downloaded feature packages where used.

assets.authority: Indiana Geographic Information Office / Indiana local governments
assets.purpose: Historical/current-framework cadastral reference for 2025 data harvest
assets.freshnessPolicy: Retain as the registered 2025 statewide framework; prefer the current parcel service when current cadastral truth is required.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash service metadata and compact extracted records; preserve state_parcel_id/parcel_id provenance.

assets.authority: Indiana Geographic Information Office / Indiana local governments
assets.freshnessPolicy: Use current service metadata; do not expose owner/address fields as public engineering anchors.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash service metadata and compact geometry extracts; preserve load date and state_parcel_id provenance.

assets.purpose: Current aerial imagery for digital-twin visualization and change detection
assets.freshnessPolicy: Use the imagery service's current published acquisition and preserve acquisition metadata/retrieval time.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash service metadata and retrieval manifests; do not bulk-commit restricted imagery.

assets.dataset: USGS 3DEP Bare Earth DEM Dynamic Image Service
assets.purpose: Elevation visualization and terrain provenance cross-check
assets.freshnessPolicy: Use the current published 3DEP dynamic service; preserve source acquisition and vertical-datum metadata. Engineering terrain products remain separately validated.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash service metadata and any materialized elevation tiles; retain source VerticalDatum/AcquisitionDate fields.

assets.purpose: Statewide elevation acquisition for terrain provenance and community-scale digital-twin context
assets.freshnessPolicy: Capture runtime ImageServer metadata before asserting source CRS, vertical datum, acquisition metadata, or operational freshness.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash service metadata and every materialized raster artifact; preserve export parameters.

assets.dataset: Wabash River at New Harmony, IN 03378500
assets.freshnessPolicy: Refresh before current-status claims; preserve observation timestamp, parameter, units, approval status and qualifier.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash normalized observation batches and retain source URL/timestamp.

assets.purpose: Live and historical Ohio River stage/discharge observations
assets.freshnessPolicy: Refresh before current-status claims; preserve observation timestamp, parameter, units, approval status and qualifier.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash normalized observation batches and retain source URL/timestamp.

assets.dataset: Ohio River at Uniontown Dam, KY 03322420
assets.purpose: Tailwater gage observation related to the John T. Myers Locks and Dam infrastructure context
assets.freshnessPolicy: Use the official USGS station identity. Do not relabel the station as the John T. Myers Locks and Dam station.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash normalized observation batches and retain source URL/timestamp.

assets.purpose: Official observed and forecast hydrologic state
assets.freshnessPolicy: Preserve forecast issuance/valid time and distinguish forecast records from observations.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash normalized forecast batches and retain issuance metadata.

assets.purpose: Levee-system inventory and flood-control infrastructure evidence
assets.freshnessPolicy: Refresh current inventory and preserve system identifier, inspection and update metadata.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash service metadata and compact extracted records.

assets.dataset: Historical Point Township plat atlas and community maps
assets.freshnessPolicy: Historical reference only; georeference only after documented control points and transformation QA.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash source scans when materialized; retain page number and source provenance.

assets.purpose: Statewide LiDAR-derived building footprint reference for 3D open-world context
assets.freshnessPolicy: Use as derived/reference geometry; do not promote to survey or current authoritative building geometry. Prefer newer permitted local authoritative datasets when available.

verification.sourceHashPolicy: Hash service metadata and any materialized feature packages; retain lidar year and county attributes.
